item.title: Barack Obama meets Microsoft executives in Washington
item.description: Barack Obama visited Redmond on Tuesday to tour Microsoft and discuss technology policy with Microsoft leadership.

item.title: United Nations envoy visits Brussels for a climate summit
item.description: A United Nations envoy arrived in Brussels this week, and the United Nations confirmed the Brussels agenda covers a new climate summit.

item.title: Town council opens a renovated library branch
item.description: The town council opened a renovated library branch downtown after months of construction work.
